supplier_terms: Nonrefundable prepaid execution slot includes labor, retries and support amounts. No actual provider consent, external capacity or legal enforceability is asserted. Overlapping active intervals share one indivisible worker.
cost_basis: Every USD amount is an explicit authored sensitivity parameter, not a quote, wage survey, measured invoice or inferred market demand. The human supervision and expert line items make this a modeled hybrid, not strict 100 percent autonomous commerce. Resource reservations are fully incurred prepaid costs; unused slots are not silently refunded.

zero_cost_explanations.borrowed_funds: No debt or financing contract is permitted in this fixture; no interest or funding proceeds.
zero_cost_explanations.actual_revenue: No real buyer, real acceptance or real payment; actual revenue is zero by scope.

horizon: Integer hours 0 through 120 inclusive; no annualization or 365-day profit claim.
successor_policy: Spend development, acquisition and production only from native unrestricted collected earnings after first maturity and declared tax provision. Seed remains available but excluded by this registered policy; causal necessity of first earnings is not claimed.
threat_model: Trusted local POSIX storage, one account and mandatory native exclusive writer lease; accidental malformed data, overlap, replay, crashes and tampering are tested. No Byzantine supplier, remote multi-account allocator, host compromise or disaster recovery guarantee. Native signatures authenticate local simulation authority, not real counterparties.
